from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Full name or identifier of the party")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case, e.g. Appellant, Defendant, Applicant")

class MonetaryItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial order or amount mentioned in the verdict."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The monetary amount specified")
    payer_or_payee: str | None = Field(description="Who pays or who receives the amount")
    description: str | None = Field(description="Purpose of the amount, e.g. fine, compensation, fee")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(default="CNY", description="Currency unit")

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="Document title or identifier, e.g. 《判决文书 1》")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal case or procedure")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Official court case number")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the judgment")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties named in the document")
    verdict_outcome: str | None = Field(description="The main ruling or outcome described in the document")
    monetary_items: list[MonetaryItem] = Field(description="Any financial orders or damages detailed")
    appeal_result: str | None = Field(description="Result regarding appeals, e.g. dismissed, upheld")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted document facts from the current context."""
    documents: list[Document]
